data.name: Asantria
data.detailed_description:
Long ago, the emperor of the Asentria Empire united the warring peoples of four continents, creating a global state. However, peace is hindered by the presence of pervasive, dangerous magic and creatures and monsters that coexist with humans, often brutally. The empire's population has also developed various cults that threaten the emperor's position. In desperation, he goes to a seer who predicts the arrival of a chosen one who will eliminate the creatures! It turns out that this chosen one is the young man you will play in this intriguing adventure, which will take you to the farthest reaches of the kingdom to destroy the creatures and monsters known from legend and myth! Time to begin the monster hunt!

An intriguing top-down game with a cartoonish pixel art style! Move around the map in all directions while viewing your character from above! Use various types of magic to shoot and fight monsters!

Also use different outfits that will give you additional advantages in the game world!

A variety of enemies with different ways to defeat you! Don't give up and defeat them!:

Various magic moves and combat mechanics!:

Will you survive in a world of monsters, magic and darkness?:

More about the game:

In the game, we'll be able to play in different regions of the United Empire. In each region, we'll have one or more open maps. On each map, we must find and eliminate all creatures and magical monsters. Each map will have information about which creatures we need to eliminate and how many there are. There will also be unusual creatures marked with question marks; only after finding them will we learn what they are. Hmmm, is that all? No! Each map will also feature quests related to some of the creatures and quests related to the region's inhabitants. In the game, we'll be able to trade with NPCs, buying items such as outfits or food to regenerate health. The in-game currency is gold, which we earn by completing monster missions and through certain interactions with the environment, such as finding treasure! Regions in the game:

- Asantria - The center of the united empire where we begin the game - A region inspired by the legends and myths of European lands.

- Hermos - A desert region inspired by the myths and legends of Africa.

- Juntus - A winter region inspired by the frosty reaches of Siberia.

- Tehos - A region inspired by the legends and myths of North America.

- Antson - A region inspired by the myths and legends of Asia.

Costumes in the game are an important factor. By acquiring or purchasing them, you gain additional skills and mechanics! For example, with the Plague Suit, you can breathe freely in areas filled with toxic fumes, and with the suit that injects you with Venom serum, you can move faster, fire more magic projectiles, and have more health—these are just two of many available costumes in the game! Combat in the game revolves around shooting magic projectiles. You'll be able to master several types of magic, each with a different projectile that deals different damage and has different abilities: 

1. Blue Magic - basic magic, medium damage.

2. Fire Magic - high damage to enemies, but your hero suffers little damage when fired.

3. Nature Magic - low damage to enemies, but each enemy hit adds a few health points.

4. Dark Magic - you'll have to find out for yourself; it's arcane knowledge!
